blurb.vi: Bà Thảo lần đầu đi máy bay.
blurb.en: Mrs Thao flies for the first time.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mrs Thao is sixty-five, and she has never been on a plane.

translation.vi: Bà Thảo sáu mươi lăm tuổi và chưa bao giờ đi máy bay.
translation.en: Mrs Thao is sixty-five, and she has never been on a plane.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Her son Khanh wants to take her on vacation to Da Nang.

translation.vi: Con trai bà là Khánh muốn đưa bà đi nghỉ ở Đà Nẵng.
translation.en: Her son Khanh wants to take her on vacation to Da Nang.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Mother, we fly on Friday. I already have the tickets.

translation.vi: Mẹ ơi, thứ Sáu mình bay. Con có vé rồi.
translation.en: Mother, we fly on Friday. I already have the tickets.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Fly? I am too old for that! Can't we travel by train?

translation.vi: Bay à? Mẹ già quá rồi! Mình đi tàu không được à?
translation.en: Fly? I am too old for that! Can't we travel by train?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: The train takes twenty hours, and the flight takes one hour.

translation.vi: Đi tàu mất hai mươi tiếng, còn máy bay chỉ một tiếng.
translation.en: The train takes twenty hours, and the flight takes one hour.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Friday morning, Mrs Thao is excited, but she is also worried.

translation.vi: Sáng thứ Sáu, bà Thảo háo hức, nhưng cũng lo lắng.
translation.en: On Friday morning, Mrs Thao is excited, but she is also worried.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At the airport, Khanh shows their tickets, and they sit near a window.

translation.vi: Ở sân bay, Khánh đưa vé, rồi hai mẹ con ngồi gần cửa sổ.
translation.en: At the airport, Khanh shows their tickets, and they sit near a window.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Khanh, why is the plane moving? I am afraid!

translation.vi: Khánh ơi, sao máy bay đang chạy thế? Mẹ sợ quá!
translation.en: Khanh, why is the plane moving? I am afraid!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Don't worry, Mother. Hold my hand and look out of the window.

translation.vi: Mẹ đừng lo. Mẹ nắm tay con và nhìn ra cửa sổ đi.
translation.en: Don't worry, Mother. Hold my hand and look out of the window.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: After a few minutes, the plane is high over the city.

translation.vi: Vài phút sau, máy bay đã ở cao trên thành phố.
translation.en: After a few minutes, the plane is high over the city.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Oh! Look at the river and the little houses!

translation.vi: Ồ! Nhìn con sông và những ngôi nhà nhỏ kìa!
translation.en: Oh! Look at the river and the little houses!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: A woman comes with juice and water.

translation.vi: Một cô gái mang nước ép và nước đến.
translation.en: A woman comes with juice and water.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Are you thirsty, Mother?

translation.vi: Mẹ có khát không?
translation.en: Are you thirsty, Mother?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, I would like some juice, please.

translation.vi: Có, cho mẹ ít nước ép.
translation.en: Yes, I would like some juice, please.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The flight is soon over, and they arrive in Da Nang.

translation.vi: Chuyến bay chẳng mấy chốc đã kết thúc, và họ đến Đà Nẵng.
translation.en: The flight is soon over, and they arrive in Da Nang.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That was easy! I want to do it again.

translation.vi: Dễ mà! Mẹ muốn đi nữa.
translation.en: That was easy! I want to do it again.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You said you were too old!

translation.vi: Mẹ bảo mẹ già quá mà!
translation.en: You said you were too old!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I can fly once a year, can't I? Next time, let's go to Japan!

translation.vi: Mỗi năm bay một lần cũng được chứ nhỉ? Lần sau mình đi Nhật nhé!
translation.en: I can fly once a year, can't I? Next time, let's go to Japan!

blurb.vi: Yến giúp một ông cụ qua đường.
blurb.en: Yen helps an old man cross the road.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Yen is a student, and she lives near a big road in Hanoi.

translation.vi: Yến là sinh viên, sống gần một con đường lớn ở Hà Nội.
translation.en: Yen is a student, and she lives near a big road in Hanoi.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Every morning, she walks to the university.

translation.vi: Sáng nào cô cũng đi bộ đến trường đại học.
translation.en: Every morning, she walks to the university.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The traffic on this road is very fast and very dangerous.

translation.vi: Xe cộ trên đường này chạy rất nhanh và rất nguy hiểm.
translation.en: The traffic on this road is very fast and very dangerous.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: One day, she sees an old man at the side of the road.

translation.vi: Một hôm, cô thấy một ông cụ đứng bên đường.
translation.en: One day, she sees an old man at the side of the road.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He wants to go to the pharmacy, but he is afraid to cross.

translation.vi: Ông muốn đến hiệu thuốc, nhưng không dám sang đường.
translation.en: He wants to go to the pharmacy, but he is afraid to cross.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Excuse me, sir. Can I help you?

translation.vi: Cháu chào ông. Cháu giúp ông được không ạ?
translation.en: Excuse me, sir. Can I help you?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thank you. My eyes are bad, and I can't see the traffic light.

translation.vi: Cảm ơn cháu. Mắt ông kém, không nhìn thấy đèn giao thông.
translation.en: Thank you. My eyes are bad, and I can't see the traffic light.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Let's walk to the corner. There is a sign and a traffic light.

translation.vi: Mình đi đến góc phố đi ông. Ở đó có biển báo và đèn giao thông.
translation.en: Let's walk to the corner. There is a sign and a traffic light.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She holds his arm, and they walk slowly to the corner.

translation.vi: Cô đỡ tay ông, và họ từ từ đi đến góc phố.
translation.en: She holds his arm, and they walk slowly to the corner.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Wait, please. The light is red.

translation.vi: Chờ đã ông ơi. Đèn đang đỏ.
translation.en: Wait, please. The light is red.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: A motorbike goes past very fast, and the driver doesn't look.

translation.vi: Một chiếc xe máy phóng rất nhanh qua, người lái chẳng nhìn gì cả.
translation.en: A motorbike goes past very fast, and the driver doesn't look.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: People here are not careful! When I was young, this road was quiet.

translation.vi: Người ta ở đây chẳng cẩn thận gì cả! Hồi ông còn trẻ, đường này yên tĩnh lắm.
translation.en: People here are not careful! When I was young, this road was quiet.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Now it is green. We can cross.

translation.vi: Giờ đèn xanh rồi. Mình sang được rồi ạ.
translation.en: Now it is green. We can cross.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: They cross together, and they stop in front of the pharmacy.

translation.vi: Họ cùng nhau sang đường, và dừng trước hiệu thuốc.
translation.en: They cross together, and they stop in front of the pharmacy.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You are very kind. What is your name?

translation.vi: Cháu tốt bụng quá. Cháu tên là gì?
translation.en: You are very kind. What is your name?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: My name is Yen. Be careful, sir!

translation.vi: Cháu tên Yến ạ. Ông cẩn thận nhé!
translation.en: My name is Yen. Be careful, sir!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: After that day, Yen often sees the old man on the road.

translation.vi: Từ hôm đó, Yến thường gặp ông cụ trên đường.
translation.en: After that day, Yen often sees the old man on the road.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He always smiles and says, "Hello, Yen!"

translation.vi: Ông luôn mỉm cười và nói: "Chào Yến!"
translation.en: He always smiles and says, "Hello, Yen!"

prompt.en: Why doesn't the old man cross?

options.en: His eyes are bad and he is afraid

prompt.en: What does the old man think of Yen?

blurb.vi: Cuộc thi hát trong bữa tiệc công ty.
blurb.en: A singing game at the company party.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Every December, Phuong's company has a big party.

translation.vi: Tháng Mười Hai năm nào công ty của Phương cũng tổ chức một bữa tiệc lớn.
translation.en: Every December, Phuong's company has a big party.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: This year, the party is at a hotel near the river.

translation.vi: Năm nay, tiệc ở một khách sạn gần sông.
translation.en: This year, the party is at a hotel near the river.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Phuong wears a blue dress, and she has a new color in her hair.

translation.vi: Phương mặc váy xanh và nhuộm tóc màu mới.
translation.en: Phuong wears a blue dress, and she has a new color in her hair.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Phuong, your hair looks great! Are you ready to sing?

translation.vi: Phương ơi, tóc em đẹp quá! Em sẵn sàng hát chưa?
translation.en: Phuong, your hair looks great! Are you ready to sing?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Sing? No! I can't sing, and I can't dance!

translation.vi: Hát á? Không! Em không biết hát, cũng không biết nhảy!
translation.en: Sing? No! I can't sing, and I can't dance!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: But every team must do something. It is the rule.

translation.vi: Nhưng đội nào cũng phải làm gì đó. Đó là quy định mà.
translation.en: But every team must do something. It is the rule.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: First, the staff from the office sing a song about their boss.

translation.vi: Đầu tiên, nhân viên văn phòng hát một bài về sếp của họ.
translation.en: First, the staff from the office sing a song about their boss.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Everyone laughs, and the boss laughs too.

translation.vi: Mọi người cười, sếp cũng cười.
translation.en: Everyone laughs, and the boss laughs too.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Then the workers from the factory dance together.

translation.vi: Rồi các công nhân nhà máy cùng nhau nhảy.
translation.en: Then the workers from the factory dance together.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Now it is our turn, Phuong. Come on!

translation.vi: Đến lượt mình rồi, Phương. Lên nào!
translation.en: Now it is our turn, Phuong. Come on!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I am afraid. My face is red!

translation.vi: Em sợ lắm. Mặt em đỏ cả rồi!
translation.en: I am afraid. My face is red!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Just listen to the music and smile.

translation.vi: Cứ nghe nhạc và mỉm cười thôi.
translation.en: Just listen to the music and smile.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Her team starts a song from their favorite movie.

translation.vi: Đội của chị bắt đầu một bài hát trong bộ phim họ yêu thích.
translation.en: Her team starts a song from their favorite movie.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At first Phuong sings very slowly, but soon she enjoys it.

translation.vi: Lúc đầu Phương hát rất chậm, nhưng chẳng mấy chốc chị thấy thích.
translation.en: At first Phuong sings very slowly, but soon she enjoys it.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At the end, she dances with the boss's wife.

translation.vi: Cuối cùng, chị nhảy với vợ của sếp.
translation.en: At the end, she dances with the boss's wife.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The people from every team say her song was the best.

translation.vi: Mọi người trong các đội đều nói bài hát của chị là hay nhất.
translation.en: The people from every team say her song was the best.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That was great! Can we do it again next year?

translation.vi: Tuyệt quá! Sang năm mình làm lại nhé?
translation.en: That was great! Can we do it again next year?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You said you can't sing!

translation.vi: Em bảo em không biết hát mà!
translation.en: You said you can't sing!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Well, now I know I can.

translation.vi: Thì bây giờ em biết là em hát được rồi.
translation.en: Well, now I know I can.

blurb.vi: Hiền gửi nhầm email cho cả công ty.
blurb.en: Hien sends an email to the wrong people.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hien works in an office, and she writes many emails every day.

translation.vi: Hiền làm ở văn phòng và ngày nào cũng viết nhiều email.
translation.en: Hien works in an office, and she writes many emails every day.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: One afternoon, her friend Thao sends her a message about their manager.

translation.vi: Một buổi chiều, bạn chị là Thảo nhắn cho chị một tin về quản lý của họ.
translation.en: One afternoon, her friend Thao sends her a message about their manager.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The message says that the manager's new jacket is too small.

translation.vi: Tin nhắn nói áo khoác mới của quản lý chật quá.
translation.en: The message says that the manager's new jacket is too small.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hien laughs and writes a reply, but she is very busy.

translation.vi: Hiền cười và viết trả lời, nhưng chị đang rất bận.
translation.en: Hien laughs and writes a reply, but she is very busy.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She presses the button, and the email goes to all the staff!

translation.vi: Chị nhấn nút, và email đi đến toàn bộ nhân viên!
translation.en: She presses the button, and the email goes to all the staff!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Oh, no! What can I do?

translation.vi: Ôi không! Mình phải làm sao đây?
translation.en: Oh, no! What can I do?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She looks at the screen. It is too late.

translation.vi: Chị nhìn màn hình. Muộn mất rồi.
translation.en: She looks at the screen. It is too late.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: A few minutes later, her colleague Tuan comes to her desk.

translation.vi: Vài phút sau, đồng nghiệp là Tuấn đến bàn chị.
translation.en: A few minutes later, her colleague Tuan comes to her desk.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hien, I read your email. The jacket really is small!

translation.vi: Hiền ơi, anh đọc email của em rồi. Cái áo khoác đúng là chật thật!
translation.en: Hien, I read your email. The jacket really is small!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Please stop. I am very worried. Does the manager know?

translation.vi: Thôi đi anh. Em lo lắm. Quản lý biết chưa?
translation.en: Please stop. I am very worried. Does the manager know?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Maybe not. He is at a meeting, and he forgot his password.

translation.vi: Chắc chưa. Ông ấy đang họp, mà lại quên mật khẩu.
translation.en: Maybe not. He is at a meeting, and he forgot his password.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Really? So he can't read his email?

translation.vi: Thật à? Vậy ông ấy không đọc được email à?
translation.en: Really? So he can't read his email?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Not today. But he will read it tomorrow.

translation.vi: Hôm nay thì không. Nhưng mai ông ấy sẽ đọc.
translation.en: Not today. But he will read it tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hien thinks for a long time. Then she walks to the manager's office.

translation.vi: Hiền nghĩ rất lâu. Rồi chị đi đến phòng quản lý.
translation.en: Hien thinks for a long time. Then she walks to the manager's office.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Excuse me, Mr Pham. I have something to tell you. I sent a bad email.

translation.vi: Xin lỗi ông Phạm. Tôi có chuyện muốn nói. Tôi đã gửi một email không hay.
translation.en: Excuse me, Mr Pham. I have something to tell you. I sent a bad email.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She tells him everything, and her face is red.

translation.vi: Chị kể hết với ông, mặt đỏ bừng.
translation.en: She tells him everything, and her face is red.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Is that all? My wife said the same thing about this jacket.

translation.vi: Chỉ thế thôi à? Vợ tôi cũng nói y như vậy về cái áo này.
translation.en: Is that all? My wife said the same thing about this jacket.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thank you for telling me. But please read before you press the button!

translation.vi: Cảm ơn chị đã nói. Nhưng lần sau đọc kỹ trước khi nhấn nút nhé!
translation.en: Thank you for telling me. But please read before you press the button!

blurb.vi: Một cuộc gọi nhầm số dẫn đến một cuộc hẹn khám.
blurb.en: A wrong number and an appointment at the clinic.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Mrs Huong has a bad cough, so she calls the clinic on Monday morning.

translation.vi: Bà Hương bị ho nặng nên sáng thứ Hai gọi điện đến phòng khám.
translation.en: Mrs Huong has a bad cough, so she calls the clinic on Monday morning.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Hello, is this the Green Clinic?

translation.vi: A lô, có phải phòng khám Xanh không ạ?
translation.en: Hello, is this the Green Clinic?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: No, this is Tom's Restaurant. I think you have the wrong number.

translation.vi: Không, đây là nhà hàng của Tom. Chắc bà gọi nhầm số rồi.
translation.en: No, this is Tom's Restaurant. I think you have the wrong number.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Oh, I am sorry. Goodbye.

translation.vi: Ồ, tôi xin lỗi. Tạm biệt.
translation.en: Oh, I am sorry. Goodbye.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She looks at her phone. The number is 2265, not 2256.

translation.vi: Bà nhìn điện thoại. Số là 2265, không phải 2256.
translation.en: She looks at her phone. The number is 2265, not 2256.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She calls again, and a man answers the phone.

translation.vi: Bà gọi lại, và một người đàn ông nghe máy.
translation.en: She calls again, and a man answers the phone.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Green Clinic, good morning. How can I help you?

translation.vi: Phòng khám Xanh xin chào. Tôi giúp gì được ạ?
translation.en: Green Clinic, good morning. How can I help you?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I would like an appointment with Doctor Lan, please.

translation.vi: Tôi muốn hẹn khám với bác sĩ Lan ạ.
translation.en: I would like an appointment with Doctor Lan, please.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hold on, please. I will check her schedule.

translation.vi: Xin bà chờ máy. Tôi xem lịch của bác sĩ.
translation.en: Hold on, please. I will check her schedule.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She waits for a minute and listens to some music.

translation.vi: Bà đợi một phút và nghe nhạc.
translation.en: She waits for a minute and listens to some music.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Doctor Lan is busy today. Is tomorrow at ten okay?

translation.vi: Hôm nay bác sĩ Lan bận. Mai lúc mười giờ được không ạ?
translation.en: Doctor Lan is busy today. Is tomorrow at ten okay?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: No, I am at work in the morning. Is the afternoon possible?

translation.vi: Không, buổi sáng tôi đi làm. Buổi chiều có được không?
translation.en: No, I am at work in the morning. Is the afternoon possible?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yes. Is half past three good for you?

translation.vi: Được ạ. Ba giờ rưỡi có tiện cho bà không?
translation.en: Yes. Is half past three good for you?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, thank you. My name is Huong Tran.

translation.vi: Vâng, cảm ơn anh. Tôi tên là Trần Hương.
translation.en: Yes, thank you. My name is Huong Tran.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Do you have a card from our clinic?

translation.vi: Bà có thẻ của phòng khám không ạ?
translation.en: Do you have a card from our clinic?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, and my phone number is on it.

translation.vi: Có, số điện thoại của tôi cũng ở trên đó.
translation.en: Yes, and my phone number is on it.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thank you, Mrs Tran. See you tomorrow at half past three.

translation.vi: Cảm ơn bà Trần. Hẹn gặp bà ba giờ rưỡi ngày mai.
translation.en: Thank you, Mrs Tran. See you tomorrow at half past three.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: That night, her family orders dinner from Tom's, and she laughs.

translation.vi: Tối đó, gia đình bà gọi món ăn từ nhà hàng của Tom, và bà bật cười.
translation.en: That night, her family orders dinner from Tom's, and she laughs.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She knows that number very well now.

translation.vi: Giờ thì bà thuộc lòng số đó rồi.
translation.en: She knows that number very well now.

blurb.vi: Trang luôn đi làm muộn vì xe buýt.
blurb.en: Trang is often late because of the bus.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Trang works at a shop in the middle of Saigon.

translation.vi: Trang làm ở một cửa hàng giữa trung tâm Sài Gòn.
translation.en: Trang works at a shop in the middle of Saigon.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She takes bus number 19 to work every day.

translation.vi: Ngày nào chị cũng đi xe buýt số 19 đi làm.
translation.en: She takes bus number 19 to work every day.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The schedule says that the bus comes at ten past seven.

translation.vi: Lịch ghi xe đến lúc bảy giờ mười.
translation.en: The schedule says that the bus comes at ten past seven.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: But the bus is often late, and sometimes it is full.

translation.vi: Nhưng xe thường đến muộn, thỉnh thoảng lại đầy khách.
translation.en: But the bus is often late, and sometimes it is full.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Once, she stood at the bus stop for forty minutes in the rain.

translation.vi: Có lần chị đứng ở bến xe bốn mươi phút trong mưa.
translation.en: Once, she stood at the bus stop for forty minutes in the rain.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You are late again, Trang.

translation.vi: Em lại đến muộn rồi, Trang.
translation.en: You are late again, Trang.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I am very sorry, Mr Binh. The bus was late.

translation.vi: Em rất xin lỗi anh Bình. Xe buýt đến muộn ạ.
translation.en: I am very sorry, Mr Binh. The bus was late.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That is the third time this week. Our customers wait for you.

translation.vi: Lần thứ ba trong tuần rồi đấy. Khách hàng đang đợi em.
translation.en: That is the third time this week. Our customers wait for you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Trang is worried. She needs this job, and she doesn't want to lose it.

translation.vi: Trang lo lắng. Chị cần công việc này và không muốn mất nó.
translation.en: Trang is worried. She needs this job, and she doesn't want to lose it.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: That night, she looks at a map of the city with her husband.

translation.vi: Tối đó, chị xem bản đồ thành phố cùng chồng.
translation.en: That night, she looks at a map of the city with her husband.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Why don't you take the bus from Le Street? It is near us.

translation.vi: Sao em không đi xe buýt từ phố Lê? Gần nhà mình mà.
translation.en: Why don't you take the bus from Le Street? It is near us.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: But that bus goes around the river. It is slow.

translation.vi: Nhưng xe đó đi vòng qua sông. Chậm lắm.
translation.en: But that bus goes around the river. It is slow.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Then leave ten minutes early and walk along the river to the next stop.

translation.vi: Vậy thì đi sớm mười phút và đi bộ dọc sông đến bến sau.
translation.en: Then leave ten minutes early and walk along the river to the next stop.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The next morning, Trang tries it, and she has a nice walk.

translation.vi: Sáng hôm sau, Trang thử, và chị có một đoạn đi bộ thật dễ chịu.
translation.en: The next morning, Trang tries it, and she has a nice walk.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She doesn't miss the bus, and it has many free seats.

translation.vi: Chị không lỡ xe, và xe còn nhiều chỗ trống.
translation.en: She doesn't miss the bus, and it has many free seats.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She arrives at the shop at five to eight, with a big smile.

translation.vi: Chị đến cửa hàng lúc tám giờ kém năm, cười thật tươi.
translation.en: She arrives at the shop at five to eight, with a big smile.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You are early today! What happened?

translation.vi: Hôm nay em đến sớm thế! Có chuyện gì à?
translation.en: You are early today! What happened?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Nothing. I only changed my road to work.

translation.vi: Không có gì ạ. Em chỉ đổi đường đi làm thôi.
translation.en: Nothing. I only changed my road to work.

prompt.en: Which bus does Trang take?

prompt.vi: Chồng Trang gợi ý gì?
prompt.en: What does Trang's husband suggest?

options.vi: Đi sớm và đi bộ dọc sông
options.en: Leave early and walk along the river

prompt.en: Why is her boss surprised at the end?

options.en: Because she has a new uniform

blurb.vi: Đồng nghiệp Ấn Độ tập nói tiếng Việt.
blurb.en: A colleague from India tries to speak Vietnamese.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Raj is an engineer from India, and he works in a factory in Bac Ninh.

translation.vi: Raj là kỹ sư người Ấn Độ, làm việc ở một nhà máy tại Bắc Ninh.
translation.en: Raj is an engineer from India, and he works in a factory in Bac Ninh.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He is the only foreign worker in his team.

translation.vi: Anh là người nước ngoài duy nhất trong đội.
translation.en: He is the only foreign worker in his team.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At work, he speaks English with the managers.

translation.vi: Ở chỗ làm, anh nói tiếng Anh với các quản lý.
translation.en: At work, he speaks English with the managers.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: But he wants to talk with everyone, so he decides to learn Vietnamese.

translation.vi: Nhưng anh muốn nói chuyện với mọi người nên quyết định học tiếng Việt.
translation.en: But he wants to talk with everyone, so he decides to learn Vietnamese.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Mai, can you teach me some words?

translation.vi: Mai ơi, em dạy anh mấy từ được không?
translation.en: Mai, can you teach me some words?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Of course! You teach me English, and I can teach you Vietnamese.

translation.vi: Tất nhiên rồi! Anh dạy em tiếng Anh, em dạy anh tiếng Việt.
translation.en: Of course! You teach me English, and I can teach you Vietnamese.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Every day at lunch, they sit together with their food.

translation.vi: Trưa nào họ cũng ngồi ăn cùng nhau.
translation.en: Every day at lunch, they sit together with their food.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Monday, Raj learns the words for food and numbers.

translation.vi: Thứ Hai, Raj học các từ về đồ ăn và số.
translation.en: On Monday, Raj learns the words for food and numbers.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Friday, he goes to the market to try them.

translation.vi: Thứ Sáu, anh ra chợ thử dùng.
translation.en: On Friday, he goes to the market to try them.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Hello! I want to buy two fish, please.

translation.vi: Chào chị! Cho tôi mua hai con cá.
translation.en: Hello! I want to buy two fish, please.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He says it in Vietnamese, but the woman in the shop looks at him and laughs.

translation.vi: Anh nói bằng tiếng Việt, nhưng cô bán hàng nhìn anh rồi cười.
translation.en: He says it in Vietnamese, but the woman in the shop looks at him and laughs.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Two what? You want two dogs?

translation.vi: Hai gì cơ? Anh muốn hai con chó à?
translation.en: Two what? You want two dogs?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Vietnamese is a hard language, and one small change makes a different word.

translation.vi: Tiếng Việt là một ngôn ngữ khó, chỉ thay đổi một chút là thành từ khác.
translation.en: Vietnamese is a hard language, and one small change makes a different word.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Raj's face is red, but he laughs too.

translation.vi: Mặt Raj đỏ lên, nhưng anh cũng cười.
translation.en: Raj's face is red, but he laughs too.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Monday, he tells the story to his team.

translation.vi: Thứ Hai, anh kể chuyện này với cả đội.
translation.en: On Monday, he tells the story to his team.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That is okay, Raj. Say it again, slowly. Listen to me.

translation.vi: Không sao đâu, Raj. Nói lại đi, chậm thôi. Nghe em này.
translation.en: That is okay, Raj. Say it again, slowly. Listen to me.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Now everyone in the team teaches him a word every day.

translation.vi: Bây giờ mọi người trong đội mỗi ngày dạy anh một từ.
translation.en: Now everyone in the team teaches him a word every day.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He says many wrong things, but he has many friends, too.

translation.vi: Anh nói sai nhiều, nhưng anh cũng có nhiều bạn.
translation.en: He says many wrong things, but he has many friends, too.

prompt.en: What is Raj's job?

prompt.en: How do Raj and Mai help each other?

options.vi: Dạy nhau tiếng Anh và tiếng Việt
options.en: They teach each other English and Vietnamese

prompt.en: Why does Raj's team help him?

blurb.vi: Đêm đông lạnh ở Sa Pa và một bé gái bị ngã.
blurb.en: A cold night in Sapa, and a little girl falls.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ngoc and her family are on a trip to Sapa, in the mountains.

translation.vi: Ngọc và gia đình đang đi chơi Sa Pa, ở vùng núi.
translation.en: Ngoc and her family are on a trip to Sapa, in the mountains.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: It is January, and the weather is very cold.

translation.vi: Đang là tháng Một, thời tiết rất lạnh.
translation.en: It is January, and the weather is very cold.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Their small hotel is very high, and the rooms are not warm.

translation.vi: Khách sạn nhỏ của họ ở trên cao, và các phòng không ấm.
translation.en: Their small hotel is very high, and the rooms are not warm.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Quang, I am cold. Can you close the window?

translation.vi: Anh Quang ơi, em lạnh. Anh đóng cửa sổ được không?
translation.en: Quang, I am cold. Can you close the window?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It is closed. Put on your jacket and your hat.

translation.vi: Đóng rồi. Em mặc áo khoác và đội mũ đi.
translation.en: It is closed. Put on your jacket and your hat.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Their little daughter Vy doesn't want to sleep.

translation.vi: Bé Vy con gái nhỏ của họ không chịu ngủ.
translation.en: Their little daughter Vy doesn't want to sleep.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She runs around the room in her shoes.

translation.vi: Bé đi giày chạy quanh phòng.
translation.en: She runs around the room in her shoes.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Vy, stop that! It is late. You can fall!

translation.vi: Vy, thôi đi con! Muộn rồi. Ngã bây giờ!
translation.en: Vy, stop that! It is late. You can fall!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: A moment later, Vy falls, and her head hurts.

translation.vi: Một lát sau, Vy ngã, và đầu bé đau.
translation.en: A moment later, Vy falls, and her head hurts.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She is very afraid, and her face is wet.

translation.vi: Bé rất sợ, mặt ướt đẫm nước mắt.
translation.en: She is very afraid, and her face is wet.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Don't worry. Let me look at it. It is not bad.

translation.vi: Đừng lo. Để anh xem. Không nặng đâu.
translation.en: Don't worry. Let me look at it. It is not bad.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Quang goes down to the woman at the hotel desk.

translation.vi: Quang xuống gặp cô ở quầy khách sạn.
translation.en: Quang goes down to the woman at the hotel desk.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Is there a doctor in the village?

translation.vi: Trong làng có bác sĩ không ạ?
translation.en: Is there a doctor in the village?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, she is my sister. I can call her for you.

translation.vi: Có, là em gái tôi. Tôi gọi giúp anh.
translation.en: Yes, she is my sister. I can call her for you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The doctor comes in ten minutes, and she looks at Vy's head.

translation.vi: Mười phút sau bác sĩ đến và xem đầu Vy.
translation.en: The doctor comes in ten minutes, and she looks at Vy's head.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: She is fine. Give her some warm milk, and let her sleep.

translation.vi: Bé không sao. Cho bé uống sữa ấm rồi để bé ngủ.
translation.en: She is fine. Give her some warm milk, and let her sleep.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Soon Vy is sleeping between her mother and her father.

translation.vi: Chẳng mấy chốc Vy đã ngủ giữa bố và mẹ.
translation.en: Soon Vy is sleeping between her mother and her father.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Now I am warm too. But I can't sleep!

translation.vi: Giờ em cũng ấm rồi. Nhưng em không ngủ được!
translation.en: Now I am warm too. But I can't sleep!

prompt.vi: Câu chuyện xảy ra ở đâu?
prompt.en: Where does the story happen?

prompt.vi: Vì sao Vy bị ngã?
prompt.en: Why does Vy fall?

prompt.vi: Vì sao mẹ của Vy không ngủ được ở cuối truyện?
prompt.en: Why can't Vy's mother sleep at the end?

options.en: She is still worried about her daughter

blurb.vi: Có người lấy trộm ví của Duc trên xe buýt.
blurb.en: Someone steals Duc's money on the bus.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Duc is a driver for a small company in Saigon.

translation.vi: Đức là tài xế cho một công ty nhỏ ở Sài Gòn.
translation.en: Duc is a driver for a small company in Saigon.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Last Friday he got his salary in cash and put it in his bag.

translation.vi: Thứ Sáu tuần trước anh nhận lương bằng tiền mặt và để vào túi.
translation.en: Last Friday he got his salary in cash and put it in his bag.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He took the bus home because his motorbike was at the shop.

translation.vi: Anh đi xe buýt về nhà vì xe máy đang ở cửa hàng sửa.
translation.en: He took the bus home because his motorbike was at the shop.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The bus was full, and many people were standing.

translation.vi: Xe buýt đầy người, và nhiều người phải đứng.
translation.en: The bus was full, and many people were standing.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: A young man stood very near him and looked at him.

translation.vi: Một thanh niên đứng rất sát anh và nhìn anh.
translation.en: A young man stood very near him and looked at him.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Excuse me, is this bus going to the market?

translation.vi: Xin lỗi, xe này có đi qua chợ không?
translation.en: Excuse me, is this bus going to the market?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Duc looked at the map on the wall and answered him.

translation.vi: Đức nhìn bản đồ trên thành xe và trả lời.
translation.en: Duc looked at the map on the wall and answered him.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At the next stop, the young man got off very fast.

translation.vi: Đến bến sau, người thanh niên xuống xe rất nhanh.
translation.en: At the next stop, the young man got off very fast.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: When Duc got home, he opened his bag, but the money was not there.

translation.vi: Về đến nhà, Đức mở túi, nhưng tiền không còn nữa.
translation.en: When Duc got home, he opened his bag, but the money was not there.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: What is wrong? Your face is white.

translation.vi: Có chuyện gì vậy? Mặt anh trắng bệch ra.
translation.en: What is wrong? Your face is white.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: My money! Someone stole all of it on the bus. It was a thief!

translation.vi: Tiền của anh! Có người lấy hết tiền trên xe buýt. Một tên trộm!
translation.en: My money! Someone stole all of it on the bus. It was a thief!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Are you sure? Maybe you lost it at work.

translation.vi: Anh chắc không? Hay anh để quên ở chỗ làm?
translation.en: Are you sure? Maybe you lost it at work.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: No, I am sure. That young man was standing too near me.

translation.vi: Không, anh chắc mà. Cái cậu thanh niên kia đứng sát anh quá.
translation.en: No, I am sure. That young man was standing too near me.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: They went to the police station, and Duc told them his story.

translation.vi: Họ đến đồn cảnh sát, và Đức kể lại chuyện.
translation.en: They went to the police station, and Duc told them his story.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: We know this thief. He steals from people on that bus every month.

translation.vi: Chúng tôi biết tên trộm này. Tháng nào hắn cũng lấy đồ của người đi xe đó.
translation.en: We know this thief. He steals from people on that bus every month.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Please look at these photos. Is it one of these men?

translation.vi: Anh xem những tấm ảnh này. Có phải một trong số họ không?
translation.en: Please look at these photos. Is it one of these men?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Yes, that is him, in the second photo.

translation.vi: Đúng rồi, là hắn, trong tấm ảnh thứ hai.
translation.en: Yes, that is him, in the second photo.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Two weeks later, the police called Duc, but they found only half of the money.

translation.vi: Hai tuần sau, cảnh sát gọi cho Đức, nhưng họ chỉ tìm được một nửa số tiền.
translation.en: Two weeks later, the police called Duc, but they found only half of the money.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Half is better than nothing, and now I use a bank card.

translation.vi: Một nửa còn hơn không, và giờ anh dùng thẻ ngân hàng.
translation.en: Half is better than nothing, and now I use a bank card.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Now he never carries a lot of cash on the bus.

translation.vi: Giờ anh không bao giờ mang nhiều tiền mặt trên xe buýt.
translation.en: Now he never carries a lot of cash on the bus.

prompt.en: How much money did the police find?

prompt.en: Why did the young man talk to Duc?

options.vi: Để Đức không để ý đến túi
options.en: So that Duc would not look at his bag

blurb.vi: Anh Bình gặp tai nạn trên đường đi làm.
blurb.en: Binh has an accident on his way to work.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Binh rides his motorbike to work every morning.

translation.vi: Sáng nào anh Bình cũng đi xe máy đi làm.
translation.en: Binh rides his motorbike to work every morning.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Tuesday it was raining, and the road was wet.

translation.vi: Thứ Ba trời mưa, đường ướt.
translation.en: On Tuesday it was raining, and the road was wet.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At a corner, a truck turned left very fast.

translation.vi: Đến góc phố, một chiếc xe tải rẽ trái rất nhanh.
translation.en: At a corner, a truck turned left very fast.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Binh stopped, but his bike fell, and he fell on the road.

translation.vi: Bình phanh lại, nhưng xe đổ, và anh ngã xuống đường.
translation.en: Binh stopped, but his bike fell, and he fell on the road.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: A woman saw the accident and ran to him.

translation.vi: Một phụ nữ thấy tai nạn và chạy đến.
translation.en: A woman saw the accident and ran to him.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Are you okay? Don't move! I will call the emergency number.

translation.vi: Anh có sao không? Đừng cử động! Tôi gọi số khẩn cấp đây.
translation.en: Are you okay? Don't move! I will call the emergency number.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: My leg really hurts, and I can't stand up.

translation.vi: Chân tôi đau lắm, tôi không đứng dậy được.
translation.en: My leg really hurts, and I can't stand up.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Twenty minutes later, he was at the hospital, and his wife came.

translation.vi: Hai mươi phút sau, anh đã ở bệnh viện, và vợ anh đến.
translation.en: Twenty minutes later, he was at the hospital, and his wife came.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Oh, Binh! What happened? Does it hurt?

translation.vi: Ôi, anh Bình! Chuyện gì vậy? Có đau không anh?
translation.en: Oh, Binh! What happened? Does it hurt?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I am fine, but I am worried about the money. The hospital is expensive.

translation.vi: Anh không sao, nhưng anh lo về tiền. Bệnh viện đắt lắm.
translation.en: I am fine, but I am worried about the money. The hospital is expensive.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Don't worry. You have health insurance from your company.

translation.vi: Đừng lo. Anh có bảo hiểm y tế của công ty mà.
translation.en: Don't worry. You have health insurance from your company.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Really? I forgot! Where is the card?

translation.vi: Thật à? Anh quên mất! Thẻ ở đâu nhỉ?
translation.en: Really? I forgot! Where is the card?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It is in your jacket. I will show it to the nurse.

translation.vi: Trong áo khoác của anh. Em sẽ đưa cho y tá.
translation.en: It is in your jacket. I will show it to the nurse.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: A doctor looked at his leg and said it was not broken.

translation.vi: Bác sĩ xem chân anh và nói không bị gãy.
translation.en: A doctor looked at his leg and said it was not broken.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The insurance paid for most of the bill, and Binh paid only a little.

translation.vi: Bảo hiểm trả gần hết hóa đơn, và Bình chỉ trả một ít.
translation.en: The insurance paid for most of the bill, and Binh paid only a little.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He stayed at home for one week.

translation.vi: Anh ở nhà một tuần.
translation.en: He stayed at home for one week.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: His colleagues visited him with fruit and a big card.

translation.vi: Các đồng nghiệp đến thăm anh với hoa quả và một tấm thiệp to.
translation.en: His colleagues visited him with fruit and a big card.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: When he went back to work, he drove more slowly.

translation.vi: Khi đi làm lại, anh chạy xe chậm hơn.
translation.en: When he went back to work, he drove more slowly.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Now I always wear my helmet and I leave home early.

translation.vi: Giờ anh luôn đội mũ bảo hiểm và đi sớm hơn.
translation.en: Now I always wear my helmet and I leave home early.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Good. I don't want another call like that.

translation.vi: Tốt. Em không muốn nhận cuộc gọi như thế nữa đâu.
translation.en: Good. I don't want another call like that.

prompt.en: Why was Binh worried at the hospital at first?

blurb.vi: Chị Hiền cần đơn thuốc cho con.
blurb.en: Hien needs a prescription for her son.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hien's son Bao had a fever and a bad cough for three days.

translation.vi: Con trai chị Hiền là Bảo bị sốt và ho nặng ba ngày liền.
translation.en: Hien's son Bao had a fever and a bad cough for three days.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Thursday night, she went to a pharmacy near her home.

translation.vi: Tối thứ Năm, chị đến một hiệu thuốc gần nhà.
translation.en: On Thursday night, she went to a pharmacy near her home.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Good evening. I would like some medicine for my son's cough.

translation.vi: Chào anh. Tôi muốn mua thuốc ho cho con trai.
translation.en: Good evening. I would like some medicine for my son's cough.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Is it this one? I am sorry. You need a prescription for that medicine.

translation.vi: Thuốc này à? Xin lỗi chị. Thuốc này phải có đơn thuốc.
translation.en: Is it this one? I am sorry. You need a prescription for that medicine.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: But he is very sick, and it is nine o'clock!

translation.vi: Nhưng cháu ốm lắm, mà giờ đã chín giờ rồi!
translation.en: But he is very sick, and it is nine o'clock!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I know, but it is the rule. There is a night clinic on Le Street.

translation.vi: Tôi biết, nhưng quy định là thế. Có phòng khám đêm ở phố Lê.
translation.en: I know, but it is the rule. There is a night clinic on Le Street.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: So she took Bao to the clinic in a taxi.

translation.vi: Thế là chị đưa Bảo đến phòng khám bằng taxi.
translation.en: So she took Bao to the clinic in a taxi.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The doctor checked his ears and his mouth.

translation.vi: Bác sĩ khám tai và miệng của cháu.
translation.en: The doctor checked his ears and his mouth.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: He has a bad cold, but it is not dangerous. I will write a prescription.

translation.vi: Cháu bị cảm nặng, nhưng không nguy hiểm. Tôi sẽ kê đơn thuốc.
translation.en: He has a bad cold, but it is not dangerous. I will write a prescription.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Give him this medicine twice a day, after a meal, and let him sleep.

translation.vi: Cho cháu uống thuốc này hai lần một ngày, sau bữa ăn, và để cháu ngủ.
translation.en: Give him this medicine twice a day, after a meal, and let him sleep.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: They went to the pharmacy again, and the man gave Hien the medicine.

translation.vi: Họ quay lại hiệu thuốc, và anh bán hàng đưa thuốc cho chị.
translation.en: They went to the pharmacy again, and the man gave Hien the medicine.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At home, she read the paper and looked at the bottle.

translation.vi: Về nhà, chị đọc tờ giấy và nhìn chai thuốc.
translation.en: At home, she read the paper and looked at the bottle.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Wait. This says five times a day. The doctor said twice!

translation.vi: Khoan đã. Trên này ghi năm lần một ngày. Bác sĩ nói hai lần mà!
translation.en: Wait. This says five times a day. The doctor said twice!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She called the pharmacy at once, and the man checked the prescription.

translation.vi: Chị gọi ngay cho hiệu thuốc, và anh ấy kiểm tra lại đơn.
translation.en: She called the pharmacy at once, and the man checked the prescription.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You are right. It is my mistake. I am very sorry.

translation.vi: Chị nói đúng. Là lỗi của tôi. Tôi rất xin lỗi.
translation.en: You are right. It is my mistake. I am very sorry.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I promise to be more careful, and I will bring a new paper tomorrow.

translation.vi: Tôi hứa sẽ cẩn thận hơn, và mai tôi sẽ mang tờ giấy mới.
translation.en: I promise to be more careful, and I will bring a new paper tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Thank you for telling me.

translation.vi: Cảm ơn anh đã nói cho tôi biết.
translation.en: Thank you for telling me.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: After five days, Bao was much better, and he went back to school.

translation.vi: Sau năm ngày, Bảo đỡ nhiều và đi học lại.
translation.en: After five days, Bao was much better, and he went back to school.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Now Hien always reads the paper with her medicine.

translation.vi: Giờ chị Hiền luôn đọc giấy đi kèm thuốc.
translation.en: Now Hien always reads the paper with her medicine.

prompt.vi: Vì sao lúc đầu chị Hiền không mua được thuốc?
prompt.en: Why couldn't Hien buy the medicine at first?

prompt.vi: Bác sĩ dặn uống mấy lần một ngày?
prompt.en: How many times a day did the doctor say?

prompt.vi: Điều gì có thể xảy ra nếu chị không đọc tờ giấy?
prompt.en: What could have happened if Hien had not read the paper?

options.en: Her son could not go to school

options.vi: Con chị uống quá nhiều thuốc
options.en: Her son would take too much medicine

blurb.vi: Chuyến bay của Kiên bị hủy và hành lý thất lạc.
blurb.en: Kien's flight is cancelled and his bags go missing.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Kien works for a company in Hanoi, and he needed to fly to Seoul for a meeting.

translation.vi: Kiên làm cho một công ty ở Hà Nội và cần bay sang Seoul họp.
translation.en: Kien works for a company in Hanoi, and he needed to fly to Seoul for a meeting.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: His flight was at six in the morning, so he arrived at the airport at four.

translation.vi: Chuyến bay lúc sáu giờ sáng, nên bốn giờ anh đã có mặt ở sân bay.
translation.en: His flight was at six in the morning, so he arrived at the airport at four.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He gave his luggage to the woman at the desk and went to wait.

translation.vi: Anh gửi hành lý ở quầy rồi đi đợi.
translation.en: He gave his luggage to the woman at the desk and went to wait.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At half past five, a sign on the screen said that there was a delay.

translation.vi: Năm giờ rưỡi, trên màn hình báo chuyến bay bị chậm.
translation.en: At half past five, a sign on the screen said that there was a delay.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Two hours later, a woman spoke to all the people in the room.

translation.vi: Hai tiếng sau, một cô nhân viên thông báo với mọi người trong phòng.
translation.en: Two hours later, a woman spoke to all the people in the room.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I am very sorry. Because of the weather, we must cancel this flight.

translation.vi: Chúng tôi rất xin lỗi. Vì thời tiết, chúng tôi phải hủy chuyến bay này.
translation.en: I am very sorry. Because of the weather, we must cancel this flight.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Cancel it? But I have a meeting tomorrow morning!

translation.vi: Hủy à? Nhưng sáng mai tôi có cuộc họp!
translation.en: Cancel it? But I have a meeting tomorrow morning!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: We can give you a seat on the next flight, at eleven tonight.

translation.vi: Chúng tôi có thể xếp anh vào chuyến sau, lúc mười một giờ đêm nay.
translation.en: We can give you a seat on the next flight, at eleven tonight.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: All right. And where is my luggage?

translation.vi: Được rồi. Thế hành lý của tôi đâu?
translation.en: All right. And where is my luggage?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: It will go on the same plane as you.

translation.vi: Hành lý sẽ đi cùng chuyến với anh.
translation.en: It will go on the same plane as you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Kien waited all day, and he wrote to his boss about the problem.

translation.vi: Kiên đợi cả ngày, và viết cho sếp về sự cố.
translation.en: Kien waited all day, and he wrote to his boss about the problem.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He arrived in Seoul at five in the morning, very tired.

translation.vi: Năm giờ sáng anh đến Seoul, rất mệt.
translation.en: He arrived in Seoul at five in the morning, very tired.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He looked for his suitcase, but it did not come.

translation.vi: Anh tìm va li, nhưng nó không ra.
translation.en: He looked for his suitcase, but it did not come.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Excuse me, my suitcase is lost. My clothes for the meeting are in it.

translation.vi: Xin lỗi, va li của tôi bị thất lạc. Quần áo đi họp ở trong đó.
translation.en: Excuse me, my suitcase is lost. My clothes for the meeting are in it.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Please fill in this form. We will send it to your hotel.

translation.vi: Anh vui lòng điền mẫu đơn này. Chúng tôi sẽ gửi đến khách sạn của anh.
translation.en: Please fill in this form. We will send it to your hotel.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: So Kien went to the meeting in his old shirt and without his papers.

translation.vi: Thế là Kiên đi họp với cái áo cũ và không có tài liệu.
translation.en: So Kien went to the meeting in his old shirt and without his papers.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I am very sorry about my clothes. They lost my bag at the airport.

translation.vi: Tôi rất xin lỗi về quần áo. Họ làm mất túi của tôi ở sân bay.
translation.en: I am very sorry about my clothes. They lost my bag at the airport.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The manager from Korea, Ms Kim, laughed and showed him a photo from her trip.

translation.vi: Bà Kim, quản lý người Hàn, cười và cho anh xem ảnh trong chuyến đi của bà.
translation.en: The manager from Korea, Ms Kim, laughed and showed him a photo from her trip.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That happened to me last year. Let's have some coffee and start.

translation.vi: Năm ngoái tôi cũng bị thế. Mình uống cà phê rồi bắt đầu thôi.
translation.en: That happened to me last year. Let's have some coffee and start.

blurb.vi: Thư trả lại nồi cơm hỏng ở siêu thị.
blurb.en: Thu takes a broken rice cooker back to the supermarket.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Last Saturday, Thu bought a new machine for cooking rice at the supermarket.

translation.vi: Thứ Bảy trước, Thư mua một cái nồi cơm điện mới ở siêu thị.
translation.en: Last Saturday, Thu bought a new machine for cooking rice at the supermarket.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: It cost nine hundred thousand dong, and she kept the receipt.

translation.vi: Nó giá chín trăm nghìn đồng, và chị giữ lại hóa đơn.
translation.en: It cost nine hundred thousand dong, and she kept the receipt.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Sunday, she tried to cook some rice for her family.

translation.vi: Chủ nhật, chị thử nấu cơm cho gia đình.
translation.en: On Sunday, she tried to cook some rice for her family.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: After ten minutes, there was smoke, and the light on the machine went off.

translation.vi: Sau mười phút, có khói, và đèn trên nồi tắt.
translation.en: After ten minutes, there was smoke, and the light on the machine went off.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Oh, no! It is broken, and our rice is black!

translation.vi: Ôi không! Hỏng rồi, cơm đen hết rồi!
translation.en: Oh, no! It is broken, and our rice is black!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Take it back to the shop. You can ask for a refund.

translation.vi: Em mang trả cửa hàng đi. Em có thể đòi hoàn tiền.
translation.en: Take it back to the shop. You can ask for a refund.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Monday after work, she took it to the supermarket.

translation.vi: Thứ Hai sau giờ làm, chị mang nó đến siêu thị.
translation.en: On Monday after work, she took it to the supermarket.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Hello. This machine is broken, and I would like a refund, please.

translation.vi: Chào anh. Cái nồi này hỏng rồi, tôi muốn được hoàn tiền.
translation.en: Hello. This machine is broken, and I would like a refund, please.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I am sorry, but we can only give you a new one.

translation.vi: Xin lỗi chị, chúng tôi chỉ có thể đổi cái mới.
translation.en: I am sorry, but we can only give you a new one.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I don't want a new one. It made smoke in my kitchen. That is dangerous!

translation.vi: Tôi không muốn cái mới. Nó bốc khói trong bếp nhà tôi. Nguy hiểm lắm!
translation.en: I don't want a new one. It made smoke in my kitchen. That is dangerous!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I understand, but I can't decide that. Please wait a moment.

translation.vi: Tôi hiểu, nhưng tôi không quyết được. Chị đợi một lát.
translation.en: I understand, but I can't decide that. Please wait a moment.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She waited for fifteen minutes, but no one came.

translation.vi: Chị đợi mười lăm phút, nhưng không ai đến.
translation.en: She waited for fifteen minutes, but no one came.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Then she asked for the manager, and a tall man came with a form.

translation.vi: Rồi chị hỏi gặp quản lý, và một người đàn ông cao mang mẫu đơn đến.
translation.en: Then she asked for the manager, and a tall man came with a form.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Good evening. Do you have a complaint?

translation.vi: Chào chị. Chị có khiếu nại à?
translation.en: Good evening. Do you have a complaint?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes. I don't like to complain, but your staff can't help me.

translation.vi: Vâng. Tôi không thích phàn nàn, nhưng nhân viên của anh không giúp được tôi.
translation.en: Yes. I don't like to complain, but your staff can't help me.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He looked at the receipt and at the black rice in the machine.

translation.vi: Ông nhìn hóa đơn và phần cơm đen trong nồi.
translation.en: He looked at the receipt and at the black rice in the machine.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You are right. We will give you your money back, and I am sorry.

translation.vi: Chị nói đúng. Chúng tôi sẽ hoàn tiền cho chị, và tôi xin lỗi.
translation.en: You are right. We will give you your money back, and I am sorry.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Thu got her money, and she bought a machine from another shop.

translation.vi: Thư nhận lại tiền và mua nồi ở một cửa hàng khác.
translation.en: Thu got her money, and she bought a machine from another shop.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Now she keeps every receipt in a box in the kitchen.

translation.vi: Giờ chị giữ mọi hóa đơn trong một cái hộp ở bếp.
translation.en: Now she keeps every receipt in a box in the kitchen.

blurb.vi: Hùng đọc kỹ hợp đồng trước khi ký.
blurb.en: Hung reads his contract before he signs it.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hung is a good cook, and a new restaurant in Da Nang wants to hire him.

translation.vi: Hùng là đầu bếp giỏi, và một nhà hàng mới ở Đà Nẵng muốn tuyển anh.
translation.en: Hung is a good cook, and a new restaurant in Da Nang wants to hire him.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The boss, Mrs Lee, sent him a contract by email.

translation.vi: Bà chủ, bà Lee, gửi cho anh hợp đồng qua email.
translation.en: The boss, Mrs Lee, sent him a contract by email.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Please read it and sign it by Friday. Friday is the deadline.

translation.vi: Anh đọc rồi ký trước thứ Sáu nhé. Thứ Sáu là hạn chót.
translation.en: Please read it and sign it by Friday. Friday is the deadline.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hung was very excited, and he wanted to sign at once.

translation.vi: Hùng rất háo hức, và muốn ký ngay.
translation.en: Hung was very excited, and he wanted to sign at once.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: But his wife Mai worked in a bank, and she was careful about papers.

translation.vi: Nhưng vợ anh là Mai làm ở ngân hàng và rất cẩn thận với giấy tờ.
translation.en: But his wife Mai worked in a bank, and she was careful about papers.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Wait. Let me read it first. Papers like this can be difficult.

translation.vi: Khoan đã. Để em đọc trước. Giấy tờ kiểu này khó lắm.
translation.en: Wait. Let me read it first. Papers like this can be difficult.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: That evening, they sat at the kitchen table and read every page.

translation.vi: Tối đó, họ ngồi ở bàn bếp và đọc từng trang.
translation.en: That evening, they sat at the kitchen table and read every page.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Look at page three. The salary is good, but the hours are very long.

translation.vi: Xem trang ba này. Lương tốt, nhưng giờ làm rất dài.
translation.en: Look at page three. The salary is good, but the hours are very long.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It says I must work overtime on Saturday and Sunday.

translation.vi: Ở đây nói anh phải làm thêm giờ thứ Bảy và Chủ nhật.
translation.en: It says I must work overtime on Saturday and Sunday.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, and they don't pay for it. That is not right.

translation.vi: Đúng thế, mà không trả tiền. Thế là không đúng.
translation.en: Yes, and they don't pay for it. That is not right.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: What can I do? I really want this job.

translation.vi: Anh phải làm sao? Anh rất muốn công việc này.
translation.en: What can I do? I really want this job.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Call Mrs Lee, and ask her to change it. She needs a cook, too.

translation.vi: Gọi cho bà Lee, và xin bà ấy sửa lại. Bà ấy cũng cần đầu bếp mà.
translation.en: Call Mrs Lee, and ask her to change it. She needs a cook, too.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Hung was worried, but the next morning he called her.

translation.vi: Hùng lo lắng, nhưng sáng hôm sau anh vẫn gọi.
translation.en: Hung was worried, but the next morning he called her.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Good morning, Mrs Lee. I have a question about the contract.

translation.vi: Chào bà Lee. Tôi có một câu hỏi về hợp đồng.
translation.en: Good morning, Mrs Lee. I have a question about the contract.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I am happy to work on the weekend, but I would like pay for the overtime.

translation.vi: Tôi sẵn sàng làm cuối tuần, nhưng tôi muốn được trả tiền làm thêm giờ.
translation.en: I am happy to work on the weekend, but I would like pay for the overtime.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You are right. It was a mistake from the office. I will send a new one.

translation.vi: Anh nói đúng. Văn phòng làm sai đấy. Tôi sẽ gửi bản mới.
translation.en: You are right. It was a mistake from the office. I will send a new one.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Thursday he got a new contract, and he signed it before the deadline.

translation.vi: Thứ Năm anh nhận bản hợp đồng mới và ký trước hạn chót.
translation.en: On Thursday he got a new contract, and he signed it before the deadline.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Thank you, Mai. You should be a manager!

translation.vi: Cảm ơn em, Mai. Em nên làm quản lý mới phải!
translation.en: Thank you, Mai. You should be a manager!

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I know. Now cook me some dinner, please.

translation.vi: Em biết mà. Giờ thì nấu bữa tối cho em đi.
translation.en: I know. Now cook me some dinner, please.

blurb.vi: Ngọc viết sơ yếu lý lịch để xin việc.
blurb.en: Ngoc writes a resume and applies for a job.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ngoc finished university two months ago, and she needs a job.

translation.vi: Ngọc tốt nghiệp đại học hai tháng trước và đang cần việc làm.
translation.en: Ngoc finished university two months ago, and she needs a job.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: One morning, she read about a job on a company website.

translation.vi: Một sáng, cô đọc về một công việc trên trang web của công ty.
translation.en: One morning, she read about a job on a company website.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The company sells clothes, and it wants to hire two people for its office.

translation.vi: Công ty bán quần áo và muốn tuyển hai người cho văn phòng.
translation.en: The company sells clothes, and it wants to hire two people for its office.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Mother, I want to apply for this job. But I don't have a resume.

translation.vi: Mẹ ơi, con muốn xin việc này. Nhưng con chưa có sơ yếu lý lịch.
translation.en: Mother, I want to apply for this job. But I don't have a resume.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Ask your brother Tam. He has written many.

translation.vi: Hỏi anh Tâm đi con. Nó viết nhiều rồi.
translation.en: Ask your brother Tam. He has written many.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: That evening, Tam sat with her at the computer.

translation.vi: Tối đó, Tâm ngồi cùng em bên máy tính.
translation.en: That evening, Tam sat with her at the computer.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: First, write your name, your address and your phone number.

translation.vi: Đầu tiên, viết tên, địa chỉ và số điện thoại của em.
translation.en: First, write your name, your address and your phone number.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Okay. What is next? I have no work experience.

translation.vi: Vâng. Tiếp theo là gì ạ? Em không có kinh nghiệm làm việc.
translation.en: Okay. What is next? I have no work experience.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Write about your studies and your skills. You speak English well, right?

translation.vi: Viết về việc học và kỹ năng của em. Em nói tiếng Anh tốt mà, phải không?
translation.en: Write about your studies and your skills. You speak English well, right?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, and I helped at my aunt's shop every summer.

translation.vi: Vâng, và mùa hè nào em cũng phụ cửa hàng của cô.
translation.en: Yes, and I helped at my aunt's shop every summer.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That is experience! Put it in. Don't forget it.

translation.vi: Đó là kinh nghiệm đấy! Viết vào. Đừng quên.
translation.en: That is experience! Put it in. Don't forget it.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She wrote two pages, but Tam said it was too long.

translation.vi: Cô viết hai trang, nhưng Tâm bảo dài quá.
translation.en: She wrote two pages, but Tam said it was too long.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: One page is enough. Managers are busy, and they don't read everything.

translation.vi: Một trang là đủ. Quản lý bận lắm, họ không đọc hết đâu.
translation.en: One page is enough. Managers are busy, and they don't read everything.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She made it shorter, and she checked every word for mistakes.

translation.vi: Cô viết ngắn lại và kiểm tra lỗi từng từ.
translation.en: She made it shorter, and she checked every word for mistakes.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Then she sent it with a short email to the manager.

translation.vi: Rồi cô gửi cùng một email ngắn cho quản lý.
translation.en: Then she sent it with a short email to the manager.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She waited for a week, and nothing happened. She was very sad.

translation.vi: Cô đợi một tuần, không có gì xảy ra. Cô rất buồn.
translation.en: She waited for a week, and nothing happened. She was very sad.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The next Monday, at lunch, a woman called her.

translation.vi: Thứ Hai tuần sau, vào bữa trưa, một phụ nữ gọi cho cô.
translation.en: The next Monday, at lunch, a woman called her.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Hello, this is Ms Kim. We read your resume, and we would like to meet you.

translation.vi: Chào em, chị là Kim. Chúng tôi đã đọc sơ yếu lý lịch của em và muốn gặp em.
translation.en: Hello, this is Ms Kim. We read your resume, and we would like to meet you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ngoc put down her food and smiled at her mother.

translation.vi: Ngọc đặt đồ ăn xuống và mỉm cười với mẹ.
translation.en: Ngoc put down her food and smiled at her mother.

blurb.vi: Công nhân nhà máy đình công vì tiền làm thêm giờ.
blurb.en: Factory workers stop work over overtime pay.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Lan works on the line at a big factory near Haiphong.

translation.vi: Lan làm trên dây chuyền ở một nhà máy lớn gần Hải Phòng.
translation.en: Lan works on the line at a big factory near Haiphong.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The factory makes shoes for other countries.

translation.vi: Nhà máy làm giày cho các nước khác.
translation.en: The factory makes shoes for other countries.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: For three months the workers worked overtime every Saturday.

translation.vi: Suốt ba tháng công nhân làm thêm giờ mỗi thứ Bảy.
translation.en: For three months the workers worked overtime every Saturday.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: But when they got their salary in June, there was no overtime pay.

translation.vi: Nhưng khi nhận lương tháng Sáu, không có tiền làm thêm giờ.
translation.en: But when they got their salary in June, there was no overtime pay.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Look at this. This is the same money as in January!

translation.vi: Xem này. Vẫn số tiền như tháng Một!
translation.en: Look at this. This is the same money as in January!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Mine, too. I worked twelve Saturdays. Where is my money?

translation.vi: Của anh cũng thế. Anh làm mười hai ngày thứ Bảy. Tiền của anh đâu?
translation.en: Mine, too. I worked twelve Saturdays. Where is my money?

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The workers talked at lunch, and many of them were angry.

translation.vi: Công nhân bàn nhau lúc ăn trưa, và nhiều người rất giận.
translation.en: The workers talked at lunch, and many of them were angry.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Some of them asked the manager, but he did not answer them.

translation.vi: Một số người hỏi quản lý, nhưng ông không trả lời.
translation.en: Some of them asked the manager, but he did not answer them.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: So the next morning, two hundred workers did not go in.

translation.vi: Thế là sáng hôm sau, hai trăm công nhân không vào làm.
translation.en: So the next morning, two hundred workers did not go in.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: They stood at the door of the factory. They were on strike.

translation.vi: Họ đứng ở cổng nhà máy. Họ đang đình công.
translation.en: They stood at the door of the factory. They were on strike.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I am worried. What if they don't want us after this?

translation.vi: Em lo quá. Nhỡ sau chuyện này họ không cần mình nữa thì sao?
translation.en: I am worried. What if they don't want us after this?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: They need us. No one can make shoes without workers.

translation.vi: Họ cần mình mà. Không ai làm được giày nếu không có công nhân.
translation.en: They need us. No one can make shoes without workers.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At noon, the machines were quiet, and the trucks were waiting with no shoes.

translation.vi: Đến trưa, máy móc im lặng, và các xe tải đang đợi mà không có giày.
translation.en: At noon, the machines were quiet, and the trucks were waiting with no shoes.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The company sent a woman from Hanoi to talk to them.

translation.vi: Công ty cử một chị từ Hà Nội đến nói chuyện với họ.
translation.en: The company sent a woman from Hanoi to talk to them.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I am sorry. This was a problem with our computers, and it was our mistake.

translation.vi: Tôi xin lỗi. Đây là lỗi máy tính của chúng tôi, và là sai sót của chúng tôi.
translation.en: I am sorry. This was a problem with our computers, and it was our mistake.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You will get all of your overtime pay this Friday. I promise.

translation.vi: Thứ Sáu này các bạn sẽ nhận đủ tiền làm thêm giờ. Tôi hứa.
translation.en: You will get all of your overtime pay this Friday. I promise.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The workers talked together, and they agreed to go back to work.

translation.vi: Công nhân bàn với nhau và đồng ý quay lại làm việc.
translation.en: The workers talked together, and they agreed to go back to work.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Friday, the money was in their bank cards.

translation.vi: Thứ Sáu, tiền đã vào thẻ ngân hàng của họ.
translation.en: On Friday, the money was in their bank cards.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You see, Lan? When we stand together, they listen.

translation.vi: Thấy chưa, Lan? Khi mình đứng cùng nhau, họ sẽ lắng nghe.
translation.en: You see, Lan? When we stand together, they listen.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, but next time I will read my pay paper on the first day.

translation.vi: Vâng, nhưng lần sau em sẽ đọc phiếu lương ngay ngày đầu.
translation.en: Yes, but next time I will read my pay paper on the first day.

options.en: They did not get their overtime pay
