blurb.vi: Tuấn quên gửi tệp đính kèm trước hạn chót.
blurb.en: Tuan forgets the attachment before a deadline.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Tuan works in the office of a small factory, and he writes the reports.

translation.vi: Tuấn làm ở văn phòng một nhà máy nhỏ và viết các báo cáo.
translation.en: Tuan works in the office of a small factory, and he writes the reports.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On Wednesday morning, his manager, Ms Hoa, came to his desk.

translation.vi: Sáng thứ Tư, quản lý của anh, chị Hoa, đến bàn anh.
translation.en: On Wednesday morning, his manager, Ms Hoa, came to his desk.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Tuan, the report for our customer in Japan has a deadline of five o'clock.

translation.vi: Tuấn ơi, báo cáo cho khách hàng Nhật có hạn chót lúc năm giờ.
translation.en: Tuan, the report for our customer in Japan has a deadline of five o'clock.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: No problem. I will finish it after lunch.

translation.vi: Không sao ạ. Sau bữa trưa em sẽ làm xong.
translation.en: No problem. I will finish it after lunch.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At four o'clock, he finished the report and saved the file.

translation.vi: Bốn giờ, anh viết xong báo cáo và lưu tệp.
translation.en: At four o'clock, he finished the report and saved the file.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He wrote a short email to the customer and sent it.

translation.vi: Anh viết một email ngắn gửi cho khách hàng.
translation.en: He wrote a short email to the customer and sent it.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Then he went to get some coffee, very happy.

translation.vi: Rồi anh đi lấy cà phê, rất vui.
translation.en: Then he went to get some coffee, very happy.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Ten minutes later, he got a reply from Japan.

translation.vi: Mười phút sau, anh nhận được thư trả lời từ Nhật.
translation.en: Ten minutes later, he got a reply from Japan.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Oh, no! They say there is no attachment. I forgot it!

translation.vi: Ôi không! Họ nói không có tệp đính kèm. Mình quên mất!
translation.en: Oh, no! They say there is no attachment. I forgot it!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He ran to his desk, but his computer was not working.

translation.vi: Anh chạy về bàn, nhưng máy tính không chạy.
translation.en: He ran to his desk, but his computer was not working.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The screen was black, and the printer next to it was off too.

translation.vi: Màn hình đen, và máy in bên cạnh cũng tắt.
translation.en: The screen was black, and the printer next to it was off too.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: What is wrong, Tuan? Is it your computer?

translation.vi: Có chuyện gì vậy, Tuấn? Máy tính của em à?
translation.en: What is wrong, Tuan? Is it your computer?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: My computer is broken, and it is half past four!

translation.vi: Máy tính của em hỏng rồi, mà đã bốn giờ rưỡi!
translation.en: My computer is broken, and it is half past four!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Can I borrow your computer, Ms Hoa?

translation.vi: Em mượn máy tính của chị được không ạ?
translation.en: Can I borrow your computer, Ms Hoa?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Yes, but where is your file?

translation.vi: Được, nhưng tệp của em đâu?
translation.en: Yes, but where is your file?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I saved it on the company website this afternoon.

translation.vi: Chiều nay em đã lưu nó lên trang web của công ty.
translation.en: I saved it on the company website this afternoon.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He opened it on her computer and put the password in.

translation.vi: Anh mở nó trên máy của chị và nhập mật khẩu.
translation.en: He opened it on her computer and put the password in.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: At ten minutes to five, he sent the email with the file.

translation.vi: Năm giờ kém mười, anh gửi email kèm tệp.
translation.en: At ten minutes to five, he sent the email with the file.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Good. Now you have a new rule, Tuan. Check before you press send.

translation.vi: Tốt. Giờ em có quy tắc mới rồi đấy, Tuấn. Kiểm tra trước khi nhấn gửi.
translation.en: Good. Now you have a new rule, Tuan. Check before you press send.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: The customer wrote, "Thank you. It is a very good report."

translation.vi: Khách hàng viết: "Cảm ơn. Báo cáo rất tốt."
translation.en: The customer wrote, "Thank you. It is a very good report."

prompt.vi: Hạn chót là mấy giờ?
prompt.en: What time was the deadline?

prompt.vi: Tuấn đã quên điều gì?
prompt.en: What did Tuan forget?

prompt.vi: Vì sao Tuấn vẫn kịp gửi?
prompt.en: How could Tuan still send it in time?

options.vi: Anh đã lưu tệp và mượn máy của chị Hoa
options.en: He had saved it and borrowed Ms Hoa's computer

blurb.vi: Nhà của Linh bị ngập nước và chủ nhà không giúp.
blurb.en: Water fills Linh's kitchen, and the landlord does not help.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Linh and her sister live in a small apartment in Hue.

translation.vi: Linh và em gái sống trong một căn hộ nhỏ ở Huế.
translation.en: Linh and her sister live in a small apartment in Hue.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: They pay their rent to the landlord, Mr Vo, on the first of every month.

translation.vi: Họ trả tiền thuê cho chủ nhà, ông Võ, vào ngày mùng một mỗi tháng.
translation.en: They pay their rent to the landlord, Mr Vo, on the first of every month.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: One Sunday night, Linh woke up because she heard water.

translation.vi: Một đêm Chủ nhật, Linh thức dậy vì nghe tiếng nước.
translation.en: One Sunday night, Linh woke up because she heard water.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She went into the kitchen, and the floor was wet.

translation.vi: Cô vào bếp, và sàn nhà ướt hết.
translation.en: She went into the kitchen, and the floor was wet.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Thao! Wake up! There is water all over the kitchen!

translation.vi: Thảo ơi! Dậy đi! Nước ngập khắp bếp rồi!
translation.en: Thao! Wake up! There is water all over the kitchen!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: They tried to stop it, but the water did not stop.

translation.vi: Họ cố chặn lại, nhưng nước không ngừng.
translation.en: They tried to stop it, but the water did not stop.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Linh called Mr Vo at once.

translation.vi: Linh gọi ngay cho ông Võ.
translation.en: Linh called Mr Vo at once.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It is two o'clock in the morning! Call me tomorrow.

translation.vi: Hai giờ sáng rồi! Mai hãy gọi.
translation.en: It is two o'clock in the morning! Call me tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: But Mr Vo, the water is coming into the bedroom!

translation.vi: Nhưng ông Võ ơi, nước đang chảy vào phòng ngủ!
translation.en: But Mr Vo, the water is coming into the bedroom!

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Find a plumber. It is not my problem.

translation.vi: Tìm thợ sửa ống nước đi. Đó không phải việc của tôi.
translation.en: Find a plumber. It is not my problem.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: She looked on her phone and found a plumber near her.

translation.vi: Cô tìm trên điện thoại và thấy một thợ sửa ống nước ở gần.
translation.en: She looked on her phone and found a plumber near her.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He came in twenty minutes and turned the water off.

translation.vi: Hai mươi phút sau anh ấy đến và khóa nước.
translation.en: He came in twenty minutes and turned the water off.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: This is very old. It needs a new part. That is five hundred thousand dong.

translation.vi: Cái này cũ lắm rồi. Phải thay một bộ phận mới. Năm trăm nghìn đồng.
translation.en: This is very old. It needs a new part. That is five hundred thousand dong.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Linh paid him and kept the bill.

translation.vi: Linh trả tiền và giữ hóa đơn.
translation.en: Linh paid him and kept the bill.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On the first of the month, Mr Vo came for the rent.

translation.vi: Mùng một đầu tháng, ông Võ đến lấy tiền thuê.
translation.en: On the first of the month, Mr Vo came for the rent.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: This is our rent, without five hundred thousand. This is the plumber's bill.

translation.vi: Đây là tiền thuê, đã trừ năm trăm nghìn. Đây là hóa đơn của thợ sửa.
translation.en: This is our rent, without five hundred thousand. This is the plumber's bill.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: What? You can't do that! You must pay all of the rent.

translation.vi: Cái gì? Cô không được làm thế! Cô phải trả đủ tiền thuê.
translation.en: What? You can't do that! You must pay all of the rent.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Look at our contract, Mr Vo. Page two says the landlord fixes the water.

translation.vi: Ông xem hợp đồng đi, ông Võ. Trang hai ghi chủ nhà phải sửa nước.
translation.en: Look at our contract, Mr Vo. Page two says the landlord fixes the water.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He read page two for a long time, and his face was red.

translation.vi: Ông đọc trang hai rất lâu, mặt đỏ lên.
translation.en: He read page two for a long time, and his face was red.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: All right. Next time, you can call me at any hour.

translation.vi: Thôi được. Lần sau cô cứ gọi tôi lúc nào cũng được.
translation.en: All right. Next time, you can call me at any hour.

blurb.vi: Khánh mượn tiền bạn và hứa sẽ trả.
blurb.en: Khanh borrows money from a friend and makes a promise.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Khanh and Quang lived in the same neighborhood in Hanoi when they were children.

translation.vi: Hồi nhỏ, Khánh và Quang sống ở cùng một khu phố tại Hà Nội.
translation.en: Khanh and Quang lived in the same neighborhood in Hanoi when they were children.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Now Khanh has a small business, and he sells coffee at the market.

translation.vi: Giờ Khánh có một quán nhỏ, bán cà phê ở chợ.
translation.en: Now Khanh has a small business, and he sells coffee at the market.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Last spring, his coffee machine stopped working, and he had no money for a new one.

translation.vi: Mùa xuân vừa rồi, máy pha cà phê của anh hỏng, và anh không có tiền mua cái mới.
translation.en: Last spring, his coffee machine stopped working, and he had no money for a new one.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Quang, can I borrow five million dong? I promise to pay you in three months.

translation.vi: Quang ơi, cho mình mượn năm triệu được không? Mình hứa ba tháng nữa sẽ trả.
translation.en: Quang, can I borrow five million dong? I promise to pay you in three months.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Quang had that money for his son's school, but Khanh was his old friend.

translation.vi: Quang để dành số tiền đó cho con trai đi học, nhưng Khánh là bạn cũ của anh.
translation.en: Quang had that money for his son's school, but Khanh was his old friend.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Quang's wife, Ha, was not happy about it.

translation.vi: Vợ của Quang là Hà không vui về chuyện đó.
translation.en: Quang's wife, Ha, was not happy about it.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Three months? And if he can't pay? We need that money in September!

translation.vi: Ba tháng à? Nhỡ anh ấy không trả được thì sao? Tháng Chín mình cần số tiền đó!
translation.en: Three months? And if he can't pay? We need that money in September!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: But Quang gave Khanh the money, and Khanh bought a new machine.

translation.vi: Nhưng Quang vẫn đưa tiền cho Khánh, và Khánh mua máy mới.
translation.en: But Quang gave Khanh the money, and Khanh bought a new machine.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: For two months, the business was good, and many people came for coffee.

translation.vi: Hai tháng đầu, quán làm ăn tốt, nhiều người đến uống cà phê.
translation.en: For two months, the business was good, and many people came for coffee.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Then the rain started, and the market was empty for many weeks.

translation.vi: Rồi mưa bắt đầu, chợ vắng vẻ nhiều tuần.
translation.en: Then the rain started, and the market was empty for many weeks.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: In July, Khanh had only half of the money.

translation.vi: Tháng Bảy, Khánh chỉ có một nửa số tiền.
translation.en: In July, Khanh had only half of the money.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: He didn't want to see his friend, so he stayed away from him.

translation.vi: Anh không muốn gặp bạn nên tránh mặt.
translation.en: He didn't want to see his friend, so he stayed away from him.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: See? Your friend is afraid to talk to you. I told you.

translation.vi: Thấy chưa? Bạn anh sợ không dám nói chuyện với anh. Em đã bảo mà.
translation.en: See? Your friend is afraid to talk to you. I told you.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: One evening, Quang walked to the market and sat at Khanh's table.

translation.vi: Một tối, Quang đi đến chợ và ngồi xuống bàn của Khánh.
translation.en: One evening, Quang walked to the market and sat at Khanh's table.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I am sorry, Quang. I made a promise, and I can't keep it.

translation.vi: Mình xin lỗi, Quang. Mình đã hứa, mà không giữ được lời.
translation.en: I am sorry, Quang. I made a promise, and I can't keep it.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Why don't you talk to me? Give me half now, and half in October.

translation.vi: Sao cậu không nói với mình? Đưa một nửa bây giờ, một nửa tháng Mười.
translation.en: Why don't you talk to me? Give me half now, and half in October.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Khanh gave him half that night, and Ha was a little happier.

translation.vi: Tối đó Khánh đưa một nửa, và Hà cũng đỡ giận.
translation.en: Khanh gave him half that night, and Ha was a little happier.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: In October, he came with all of the other half and a big bag of coffee.

translation.vi: Tháng Mười, anh đến với nửa còn lại và một túi cà phê to.
translation.en: In October, he came with all of the other half and a big bag of coffee.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Thank you, Khanh. But next time, please talk to us first!

translation.vi: Cảm ơn Khánh. Nhưng lần sau nhớ nói với vợ chồng em trước nhé!
translation.en: Thank you, Khanh. But next time, please talk to us first!

stories.title: Lost on the way to the wedding

blurb.vi: Vợ chồng Tâm bị lạc trên đường đến đám cưới.
blurb.en: Tam and his wife get lost on the way to a wedding.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Tam's sister was getting married in a village near Haiphong.

translation.vi: Em gái Tâm sắp cưới ở một ngôi làng gần Hải Phòng.
translation.en: Tam's sister was getting married in a village near Haiphong.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: On the morning of the wedding, Tam and his wife Thu left Hanoi very early.

translation.vi: Sáng ngày cưới, Tâm và vợ là Thu rời Hà Nội từ rất sớm.
translation.en: On the morning of the wedding, Tam and his wife Thu left Hanoi very early.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: They had a car, a gift and a big box of cakes.

translation.vi: Họ có một chiếc ô tô, một món quà và một hộp bánh to.
translation.en: They had a car, a gift and a big box of cakes.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Do you know the way? Your phone has no map.

translation.vi: Anh có biết đường không? Điện thoại anh không có bản đồ.
translation.en: Do you know the way? Your phone has no map.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Of course I know the way. I was a child there!

translation.vi: Tất nhiên anh biết đường. Hồi nhỏ anh ở đó mà!
translation.en: Of course I know the way. I was a child there!

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: An hour later, they were on a small road near a river.

translation.vi: Một tiếng sau, họ đi trên một con đường nhỏ gần sông.
translation.en: An hour later, they were on a small road near a river.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Tam, we saw that tree before. Are we lost?

translation.vi: Anh Tâm, mình thấy cái cây đó rồi. Mình lạc rồi à?
translation.en: Tam, we saw that tree before. Are we lost?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: No, no. It is near here. This neighborhood is all new.

translation.vi: Không, không. Gần đây thôi. Khu phố này mới hết.
translation.en: No, no. It is near here. This neighborhood is all new.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: After another hour, Tam stopped the car.

translation.vi: Sau một tiếng nữa, Tâm dừng xe.
translation.en: After another hour, Tam stopped the car.

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Okay, I am lost. Everything is different. All the old houses are not here.

translation.vi: Thôi được, anh lạc rồi. Mọi thứ khác hết. Mấy ngôi nhà cũ không còn nữa.
translation.en: Okay, I am lost. Everything is different. All the old houses are not here.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: An old woman was walking along the road with a bag of rice.

translation.vi: Một bà cụ đang đi dọc đường với một túi gạo.
translation.en: An old woman was walking along the road with a bag of rice.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Excuse me. We are going to a wedding in this village. Do you know the way?

translation.vi: Xin lỗi bà. Chúng cháu đi đám cưới ở làng này. Bà có biết đường không ạ?
translation.en: Excuse me. We are going to a wedding in this village. Do you know the way?

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: A wedding? You mean Hien's wedding? I am going there too! Turn right at the school.

translation.vi: Đám cưới à? Đám cưới của Hiền phải không? Bà cũng đang đi đây! Đến trường thì rẽ phải.
translation.en: A wedding? You mean Hien's wedding? I am going there too! Turn right at the school.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Thu looked at Tam, and they asked the old woman to come in the car.

translation.vi: Thu nhìn Tâm, và họ mời bà cụ lên xe.
translation.en: Thu looked at Tam, and they asked the old woman to come in the car.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: They arrived twenty minutes late, and the music had already started.

translation.vi: Họ đến muộn hai mươi phút, và nhạc đã nổi lên.
translation.en: They arrived twenty minutes late, and the music had already started.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Tam's sister ran to him in a white dress.

translation.vi: Em gái Tâm mặc váy trắng chạy đến.
translation.en: Tam's sister ran to him in a white dress.

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: You are late! And why are you with Mrs Yen?

translation.vi: Anh đến muộn! Sao anh lại đi với bà Yến?
translation.en: You are late! And why are you with Mrs Yen?

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: She is my map. I think I will stay in this village for a few weeks and learn the roads.

translation.vi: Bà ấy là bản đồ của anh đấy. Chắc anh phải ở lại làng vài tuần để học lại đường.
translation.en: She is my map. I think I will stay in this village for a few weeks and learn the roads.

sentences.speaker: N
sentences.text: Everyone laughed, and the wedding was very beautiful.

translation.vi: Mọi người cười, và đám cưới rất đẹp.
translation.en: Everyone laughed, and the wedding was very beautiful.
